skill.summary: Get instant, accurate Islamic prayer times for any UK location. Auto-detects your city or accepts any UK location name (cities, towns, boroughs). Handles typos with smart fuzzy search. Shows Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha times in 12-hour format. Uses ISNA calculation method (UK standard) via Aladhan API. Perfect for UK Muslims checking daily salah times.
